rate_table_note: Rates are in KRS 304.19-080(3)(a)1, 3 and 4, printed in words and figures. Single premiums for other than 12 monthly installments are 1/12 of the rate times the number of months ((3)(a)2). Dating: the current text took effect July 15, 2026 (2026 Ky. Acts ch. 16, SB 158, s. 21). That act prints the prior text with deletions in brackets; its only deletions in this section are the words "the provisions of this subtitle" (three times), so the rate figures are the same in the prior version, which took effect July 15, 2010 (2010 Ky. Acts ch. 24). Whether the 2010 amendment changed them was not checked. Subsection (7) makes these rates legislative prerogatives, not subject to administrative change. Also saved: archive/KY/2026-11-21_4c9aaf2d.pdf (KY-2026-Acts-ch16-SB158.pdf).

summary: Rates in force: Kentucky's maximum credit life rates in KRS 304.19-080(3): $0.60 per $100 per annum decreasing term ($0.65 with dismemberment), $0.92 per $1,000 monthly outstanding balance ($1.00), and $1.20 per $100 level term ($1.30). Fixed by statute as legislative prerogatives; unchanged by the 2026 re-enactment.
